title: Fleet & Real-Time Logistics Telemetry Dispatch
problem: Dispatchers lacked live visibility into 500+ commercial transport vehicles, resulting in route delays, idle fuel waste, and manual phone coordination.
solution: Engineered a low-latency GPS stream processing pipeline, live central dispatcher command console, and offline-resilient mobile apps for fleet drivers.
technology: React Native, Go, AWS IoT Core, Redis, TimescaleDB
result: Eliminated 28% of route deadhead mileage, cut dispatcher overhead by 40 hours weekly, and achieved a 99.4% on-time delivery metric.

title: Clinical Patient Records & Teleconsultation Portal
problem: Paper-heavy patient charting, long clinic waiting queues, and telephone appointment bottlenecks created administrative friction and patient dissatisfaction.
solution: Developed a secure, HIPAA-compliant patient portal with automated appointment booking, multi-doctor calendar sync, and encrypted lab report delivery.
technology: Next.js, Python, FastAPI, Azure Health Data Services, PostgreSQL
result: Handling 14,000+ monthly appointments with zero double-bookings, reducing clinic waiting room wait times by 65% in the first quarter of deployment.
